title: Public Book Narrative Rebuild — Chapter 1 Pass 2
diagnosis: Pass 1 improved language but kept the old technical architecture in control: X-Ray framing, FACT/ILLUSTRATION spam, data dumps, Rivers as analytical device, and site chrome fighting the book. Certified 100% measured completeness, not whether a human wants to keep reading.
old_governing_question: Did we successfully abridge the system?
new_governing_question: Can we make someone care enough to follow the argument all the way to the end?
literary_gate: Does the reader want to turn the page?
pass_2_rules: Do not preserve Pass 1 / certified-compression structure
Begin inside ordinary Arkansas life — not CC, certification, or methodology
Meet the Rivers household before explaining them; disclose composite once in author's note
Let Arkansas be place, not county dashboard
Strip data dumps and internal project vocabulary from prose
Do not explain Constitutional Capitalism in Chapter 1
Leave incomplete on purpose — hunger for where the money went
Reading room: book title → chapter → prose → prev/next
next: Cold-read Chapter 1 Pass 2. Only if the page-turn gate clears, freeze voice and rebuild 2–10.
foundational_doctrine: UNCHANGED — narrative rebuild is translation/voice, not new theory
